name: Remember Alterac Valley!
statusNote: Changed in Forever. Gives 8,300 experience instead of 11,900, 0.7 times as much. From Wowhead’s Forever database.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
Make no mistake about it, adventurer.  The Horde is quite right when they say Alterac Valley is Frostwolf Territory.

You see, the Stormpike Expedition arrived as peaceful visitors to the area in search of ore and relics.  The Frostwolves reacted with the most brutal and uncivilized act of aggression the Alliance has experienced.

Let us never forget the brave dwarves that perished in that cowardly unannounced attack.  Go now, champion, do your part in the battle for Alterac Valley.  For the Alliance!
narrative.objectives: Bring 3 Alterac Valley Marks of Honor to an Alliance Brigadier General outside the battlegrounds.
narrative.offerRewardText: You've shown great bravery in protecting our lands in Alterac Valley! I will tell my superiors of your deeds.
narrative.requestItemsText: What news do you bring from the lands of the Stormpikes? How does the battle for Alterac Valley fare?
